subject: agents
detail: The Agents MCP client uses server/discover with Stateless servers and falls back to the initialize handshake on the same connection for Legacy servers.

source.quote: Agents uses the MCP v2 client and automatically negotiates the protocol version for every connection. It uses `server/discover` with Stateless servers and falls back to the `initialize` handshake on the same connection for Legacy Streamable HTTP, SSE, and RPC servers.
